column1: # VITAL 3.0 reference doses (ED01) - Allergen Bureau, Table 1 of the VITAL 4.0 Summary and FAQ, August 2024 (VITAL 3.0 column).
# Values are mg of TOTAL PROTEIN of the allergen.
# Action Limit (ppm) = rfdMg / consumption amount (kg), capped by maxActionPpm when set.
# allergenCode holds the bcpg:allergenCode of the beCPG allergen reference data:
# regulated categories (AW gluten cereals, AC crustaceans, AE egg, AF fish, AP peanut,
# AY soy, AM milk, AS sesame, BC celery, BM mustard, UM molluscs, NL lupin) plus the
# individual tree nuts, whose reference doses differ per species.
# Sulphites (AU) carry no reference dose and keep the fixed threshold held by the allergen.
# Molluscs and buckwheat carry no VITAL 3.0 reference dose: they are deliberately
# absent here and keep the fixed threshold held by the allergen.
